ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 65% high-intensity cream pixels and 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels on the visible lobe surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity cream central zone. Low-intensity black pixels define the trailing edge and lower margin. Dense dark speckling and mottling observed along the transition zone between high and low intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Extremely jagged trailing edge with non-uniform serration; multiple peaks and valleys with pixel amplitudes varying between 5 and 20 pixels relative to the mean edge line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The visible lobe displays a strong convex sweep terminating in a sharp, tapered distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, discrete dark pixel clusters scattered within the high-intensity central region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, dark linear pixel disruption visible in the upper-central high-intensity area, oriented diagonally relative to the fluke's horizontal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A deep, irregular V-shaped notch or tissue indentation is present on the lateral/leading edge of the visible lobe, distinct from standard trailing edge serration.
